onCallSchedule.helper: An automatic rotation. New alerts are assigned to whoever the default schedule computes is on call at the moment they're received.

incidentSla.title: Incident SLAs
incidentSla.helper: How many minutes an incident of a given severity/priority has before it's considered SLA breached. Leave a cell blank to leave that pair unconfigured -- an incident with no matching policy never gets an SLA due date.

escalation.title: Escalation Chain
escalation.helper: Per severity, an ordered chain of steps -- each one notifying whoever's on shift on a chosen On-Call Schedule. An alert that stays unacknowledged ("open" or "investigating") triggers the chain automatically, advancing to the next step after its own delay and looping back to the first step once the chain is exhausted, until the alert is attended to. Manually escalating an alert (the "Escalate" button on an alert) advances the chain by exactly one step instead, independent of the automatic loop.

auditLog.title: Audit Log
auditLog.helper: Every change any admin has made across Settings -- who, what area, what action, and the before/after values. Append-only, never edited or deleted.

auditExport.title: Audit Export
auditExport.helper: Download the tenant's full alert/incident history (status changes, comments, phase transitions...) as a CEF log for import into a SIEM (Splunk, ArcSight, QRadar...).

retention.title: Retention
retention.helper: How long a closed alert or incident stays in ArgusOps after it closes, before it's permanently deleted. An open alert/incident is never deleted, no matter its age. Want to keep a copy of what gets purged? Export it first with Audit Export, above.
retention.warning: Lowering either value below an existing closed record's age causes it to be permanently deleted on the next sweep -- this cannot be undone. Evidence attached to a deleted alert/incident is not removed from wherever it's stored (S3, GCS, Google Drive, or local disk) -- only ArgusOps's own record of it.
retention.lowerConfirmBanner: This lowers a retention period below its current value -- any closed alert or incident already older than the new value will be permanently deleted on the next sweep. This cannot be undone.

databaseMigration.title: External Database
databaseMigration.helper: Migrate off the bundled Postgres container onto a database you provide. This is a one-time, assisted cutover, not a live swap -- ArgusOps reads its database connection once at startup, so the api/ingest/worker services still need a manual restart afterward with the connection strings shown below.
databaseMigration.userHint: (must be privileged enough to CREATE ROLE and CREATE EXTENSION -- not the low-privilege role ArgusOps will connect as afterward)
databaseMigration.migrateConfirm: This creates roles, replays the full schema, and copies every row onto the target. Continue?
databaseMigration.migrating: Migrating... this can take a while
databaseMigration.resultHelper: Schema is now at version {{version}}. Row counts below are what landed on the target -- source and target matched exactly, or this would have failed.
databaseMigration.restartWarning: Nothing is live yet. Set DATABASE_URL below for the api/ingest services (App connection string) and worker (Worker connection string), then restart the whole stack. Only after that restart can the bundled Postgres container be removed.
